# SocialPulse SMM

> SocialPulse is a high-speed wholesale Social Media Marketing (SMM) reseller platform and child panel SaaS provider.

## Key Resources
- [Services & Pricing](https://www.socialpulsesmm.com/services): Complete live catalog of social media marketing services with real-time wholesale rates.
- [Child Panels SaaS](https://www.socialpulsesmm.com/child-panels): Turnkey child panel deployment for launching branded reseller portals on custom domains.
- [API Documentation](https://www.socialpulsesmm.com/api): REST API documentation for automated order dispatching, balance inquiries, and status polling.
- [Platform Login](https://www.socialpulsesmm.com/login): Customer portal authentication and dashboard access.
